defs.def: a shop/store that sells food and other things used in the home. In American English ‘grocery store’ is often used to mean ‘supermarket’. 食品杂货店（在美式英语中 grocery store 常用以指 supermarket）

ex.s: My dad and I were at a grocery store last evening.
ex.t: 当收银员扫描完所有商品后，爸爸伸手去拿钱包，却愣住了。

ex.s: Jaramillo’s students live in neighborhoods where fresh food and green space are not easy to find and fast food restaurants outnumber grocery stores.
ex.t: 哈拉米略的学生居住的社区里，新鲜食物和绿地很难找到，快餐店的数量超过了杂货店。

ex.s: I remember showing my parents a video of Bea Johnson, sharing how cool I thought it would be to buy groceries with jars, and have so little trash!
ex.t: 我记得给父母看了一段比阿·约翰逊的视频，分享我认为用罐子买杂货、产生极少垃圾会是多么酷！

ex.s: A few days later, I came back with my first jars of zero waste groceries, and my dad commented on how silly it was for me to carry jars everywhere.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费杂货罐回来，我爸爸评论说，我到处带着罐子真是傻。

ex.s: I also offered to cook every so often, so I portioned out a bit of the cupboard for my own zero waste groceries.
ex.t: 我也主动提出偶尔做饭，所以我在橱柜里分出一点空间存放自己零废弃的杂货。

ex.s: What was the attitude of the author’s father toward buying groceries with jars?

ex.s: He found inspiration where others could not, in simple, everyday scenes, such as a man buying oranges at the local grocery store, or a woman riding home on the graffiti-covered subway.
ex.t: 他在别人找不到灵感的地方找到了它，在简单的日常场景中，比如一个人在当地的杂货店买橙子，或一个女人在满墙涂鸦的地铁上骑车回家。
